title: human.clarification_answer (v1)
description: The human's answer to a problem_modeling.clarification_question, correlated by question_id. Emitted with envelope.emitter == 'Human'.

question_id.description: Must match the question_id of the problem_modeling.clarification_question being answered.

answer_text.description: The human's answer, either free text or the chosen option's text.
